item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"item_id":"feed:https://www.engineering.com/?p=151563","version_id":"90e3adc0a87a45dc20689ae62db7125fe378f8191522f5954fae4ace5e96c803","decision":"accept","reason":"This is fresh, directly relevant CAD evidence: an independent trade-publication tester evaluated Backflip's new photo-, video-, and drawing-to-CAD modes on named inputs. The strongest claims were actually checked by importing downloaded STEP files into Fusion, assigning 1060 aluminum, and matching the required mass on two TooTallToby drawing challenges; the test also reports an important failure on a seven-body shelf and incomplete feature reconstruction through the Fusion add-in. It supports Backflip's commercial claim only within those conditions—mass agreement does not establish manufacturability, dimensioning reliability on real shop drawings, or robust parametric-editable output—and the photo/video assessments are largely visual rather than metrologically verified.","piece_ids":["01","02","03"]}
